channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Defrosting Dunes
item.description: An earlier image we acquired during Martian spring revealed a beautiful sequence of defrosting on polar dunes. Our goal with this observation is to repeat that and to track any changes over time in addition to resolving small scale features. Data from the CRISM instrument can aid in ice monitoring as well. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
